option_relations.rationale: Metastatic invasive lobular breast carcinoma is a type of metastatic carcinoma from an unknown primary and cutaneous metastasis from internal malignancy.
Primary invasive lobular breast carcinoma in heterotopic cutaneous breast tissue is equivalent to adenocarcinoma of mammary-like glands and ectopic breast tissue with carcinoma.
Axillary mammary-like gland adenocarcinoma is a subtype of adenocarcinoma of mammary-like glands.
Ectopic breast adenocarcinoma is a subtype of ectopic breast tissue with carcinoma.
